content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (walk-away territory)** — § 12.4 (p0046) binds Customer to a 24-month post-term, worldwide, all-product non-compete with undefined scope, failing every fallback element and contradicting § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer made no non-compete commitment.

**Cure (preferred level):** a single surgical replace of the prohibitory sentence with "Customer is subject to no non-compete or field-of-use restriction under this Agreement." — removing the operator, the duration, and the scope in one edit, with no added boilerplate. The separate no-hire covenant in the first § 12.4 was deliberately left alone as a distinct commercial term.
